WITH filtered_tracks AS (
  SELECT t.Bytes, t.Milliseconds, t.UnitPrice, mt.Name
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    Name,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
  GROUP BY Name
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as overall_avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM filtered_tracks
)
SELECT 
  mts.Name,
  mts.avg_unit_price,
  mts.avg_bytes_per_ms,
  mts.avg_bytes_per_ms / os.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms as ratio
FROM media_type_stats mts
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE os.overall_avg_bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL
